title: A.e. strong measurability of an approximate-tangent-plane projection field
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be any set (measurability is not assumed) with Hⁿ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Let Q be any map from ℝ^P to the linear subspaces of ℝ^P such that, for Hⁿ⌞M-almost every x, Q(x) is an approximate tangent space of M at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x): dim Q(x) = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_{Q(x)} f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) is blowUpMap x r). Then the field of orthogonal projections x ↦ p_{Q(x)} = (Q x).starProjection ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable (AEStronglyMeasurable for μHE[n].restrict M).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x)) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict M)
